# S648 — flag a brief sentence that is gated on role only when the matching permission grant is gated on vendor too

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**2026-11-27** — Owner decision (adj 666): a go test lint in internal/engine that fails when a BuildBrief sentence gated on role has a permission grant gated on vendor; the spec names the sentence and grant. Jon chose 'go test lint', session 8d711f67, 2026-11-27.

trust: unverified; by: Jon Robbins

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

A `BuildBrief` sentence that tells a role it may do something is only true when ork's runner grants it. Some grants are made only for some vendors, so a sentence gated on role alone can promise a write that the role's vendor does not get. The reviewer reported this in run `ork-20261125-021911-277a` (item S510) as tool feedback. Its line anchors are stale: `brief.go:146` and `runner.go:60` no longer point at the sentence or the grant. The grant is now in `claudeRunner.Run` in `internal/daemon/runner.go`, which refuses every vendor except `claude` and `claude-local` (line 33).

Two sentence/grant pairs exist today:
- **Reviewer temp-write.** The sentence "You may create and change files under your temp directory with Edit or Write" is at `internal/engine/brief.go:255`. It is gated on `reviewerWritesTMP` (`internal/engine/brief.go:194`), which checks role and vendor. The grant is `writeTMP` (`internal/daemon/runner.go:57`), given to `claude` and `claude-local`. This pair agrees.
- **UI renders directory.** The sentence "The UI renders directory ... is also an exception to the workspace limit" is at `internal/engine/brief.go:232`, inside the block gated only on `in.Role == RoleUI` (line 231). The grant is `writeDir` (`internal/daemon/runner.go:49-52`), given only when the vendor is `claude`. `TestClaudeRunnerGivesOnlyTheCloudUIPassAWriteDir` (`internal/daemon/runner_test.go:368`) pins that a `claude-local` UI pass gets no write directory. So the brief of a `claude-local`, `codex` or `grok` UI pass says it may write a directory it cannot write.

The owner decided (adj 666, `go-test-lint`, 2026-11-27) to build this as a go test lint in `internal/engine`. It fails when a `BuildBrief` sentence gated on role has a permission grant gated on vendor. The spec names the sentence and the grant, so the lint is a table of named pairs. S457 and S518 were split off as separate follow-ups.

Owner decisions, 2026-11-28: adj 666 (a go test lint) and adj 671 (gate the UI renders directory sentence on in.Vendor == claude).

## Failing tests

All tests are in `internal/engine/brief_lint_test.go` (new), package `engine`. Until the helper exists the package does not compile, so every test fails.
- TestBriefGrantLintFlagsASentenceGatedOnRoleOnly: `briefGrantViolations` is given a fake brief builder that returns the sentence for every vendor, and a pair whose grant vendors are only `claude`. It returns one error per other vendor (`claude-local`, `codex`, `codex-local`, `grok`, `grok-local`). Each error names the sentence, the role and the vendor.
- TestBriefGrantLintPassesAVendorGatedSentence: a fake builder that returns the sentence only for the pair's grant vendors and role makes `briefGrantViolations` return no errors. A fake builder that omits the sentence for a grant vendor returns one error that names the missing vendor. This guards against a lint that passes because the sentence text changed.
- TestBriefRoleGatedSentencesMatchVendorGatedGrants: for each pair in `briefGrantPairs`, builds the real brief with `BuildBrief` for every role and every vendor in `claude`, `claude-local`, `codex`, `codex-local`, `grok`, `grok-local`, and fails on any violation. The pairs are:
  - Reviewer temp-write: sentence `You may create and change files under your temp directory with Edit or Write`, role `reviewer`, grant vendors `claude` and `claude-local` (`internal/daemon/runner.go:57`).
  - UI renders directory: sentence `The UI renders directory`, role `ui`, grant vendor `claude` (`internal/daemon/runner.go:49-52`).

  Before the fix at `internal/engine/brief.go:231-232` it fails with five errors, for the UI pair on `claude-local`, `codex`, `codex-local`, `grok` and `grok-local`. The reviewer pair passes.

## Implement

1. Create `internal/engine/brief_lint_test.go` with `// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later` and `package engine`. Use only the standard library.
2. Define `type briefGrantPair struct { name, sentence, role, grantSite string; vendors []string; input func(role, vendor string) BriefInput }`. `vendors` are the vendors whose runner grants what the sentence says. `grantSite` is a `file:line` citation of the grant, for the error text. `input` returns a `BriefInput` that meets every other condition of the sentence, starting from `baseBrief()`: for the reviewer pair `ReadOnly`, a `TMPDir` and a `ProgressFile`; for the UI pair `ReadOnly` and a `TempDir`.
3. Define `var briefGrantPairs` with the two pairs named under Failing tests. Add a comment that a new `BuildBrief` sentence telling a role it may do something the runner grants only for some vendors gets a row here, with the runner site that grants it.
4. Add `briefGrantViolations(pair briefGrantPair, build func(BriefInput) (string, error)) []error`. For every role in `RoleImplementer`, `RoleReviewer`, `RoleGate`, `RoleArchitect`, `RoleUI`, `RoleSpecCheck`, `RoleSpecDraft` and every vendor in the six names above, build the brief and compute `want := role == pair.role && slices.Contains(pair.vendors, vendor)`. When `strings.Contains(brief, pair.sentence) != want`, return an error naming the sentence, the role, the vendor, `pair.grantSite` and whether the sentence is present or missing. A build error is returned as an error.
5. Add the three tests named under Failing tests. The two unit tests pass fake builders to `briefGrantViolations`. The real-brief test passes `BuildBrief` for each pair and calls `t.Error` for each violation.
6. Run `TestBriefRoleGatedSentencesMatchVendorGatedGrants`. In `internal/engine/brief.go:231-232`, gate the UI renders sentence on `in.Vendor == "claude"`, so it follows the vendor gate of the grant at `internal/daemon/runner.go:49`. Leave the CLI and TUI renders sections and every other line of that block as they are. This step assumes option 1 of the owner question below.
7. Run `go -C DIR test ./internal/engine`. If a brief golden or another test fails because the UI sentence moved, report it; do not edit the daemon grant.
